name: Maintenance product pricing source
expected: All New Maintenance products should carry Maintenance Type Defn (MTD) attribute so V21 step 39 'Derived Pricing Formula' resolves a tier (e.g. Standard=0.20) and produces NetUnitPrice = 0.20 x Source_List_Price. BoKS: PIAMBK -> MTD=Standard -> NetUnitPrice=71 (355x0.20). FIM CCM family: MTD present on products -> tier lookup -> NetUnitPrice > 0.
actual: ADVERSARIAL RE-VERIFY 2026-06-30 (v67.0, active V21) CONFIRMS the defect. BoKS PASSES: QLI 0QLWC000003kUpO4AU NetUnitPrice=71, Source_List_Price=355, ratio exactly 0.20, after a fresh independent Force-reprice (isSuccess:true). FIM FAILS: all FIM CCM New Maintenance lines net $0/null after a fresh independent Force-reprice (isSuccess:true, errorResponse:[]). CCMMSN (0QLWC000003g4QT4AY): NetUnitPrice=0, Source_List_Price=34750; CCMLSE lines (0QLWC000003g4YX4AY/g4YZ4AY/g4Ya4AI): NetUnitPrice=0/0/null, Source_List_Price=2008 each. CATALOG-LEVEL root cause confirmed at ProductAttributeDefinition: PIAMBK product 01tWC00000DD1bsYAD defines ONLY MTD (0tjWC000000096bYAA); CCMLSE product 01tWC00000DD16HYAT defines FO/UNT/NU (no MTD); CCMMSN product 01tWC00000DD16LYAT defines FO/UNT (no MTD). A real UI rep adding an FIM CCM new-maint line gets the same MTD-less attribute set -> step 39 tier lookup returns 0. Scope (re-measured, distinct active New Maintenance products WITH MTD ProductAttributeDefinition): 116 of 1683 = 6.9%; ~1567 (93.1%) missing it (larger gap than the executor's 89%).
evidence: BoKS control (PASS): https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FKRJ0A4/view -- QLI 0QLWC000003kUpO4AU NetUnitPrice=71, Source_List_Price=355 after fresh Force-reprice (isSuccess:true). Its sole live QLIA = AttributeDefinition 0tjWC000000096bYAA (Maintenance_Type_Defn). NOTE: the executor-cited QLIA Id 0zuWC0000068sUUYAY no longer exists (QLIAs regenerate on reprice); the current sole QLIA still resolves to the MTD AttributeDefinition. FIM (FAIL): https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003AqV30AK/view -- after fresh Force-reprice: 0QLWC000003g4QT4AY (CCMMSN, Net=0, SLP=34750), 0QLWC000003g4YX4AY (CCMLSE, Net=0, SLP=2008), 0QLWC000003g4YZ4AY (Net=0, SLP=2008), 0QLWC000003g4Ya4AI (Net=null, SLP=2008). Live QLIAs on FIM maint lines resolve to Feature_Options (0tjWC000000096ZYAQ), Unit_Type (0tjWC000000096kYAA), Number_of_Units (0tjWC000000096dYAA), Attribute_Volume (0tjWC0000000tqvYAA) -- NO Maintenance_Type_Defn (0tjWC000000096bYAA). CATALOG: ProductAttributeDefinition WHERE Product2Id IN (CCMLSE 01tWC00000DD16HYAT, CCMMSN 01tWC00000DD16LYAT, PIAMBK 01tWC00000DD1bsYAD) -> PIAMBK=[MTD], CCMLSE=[FO,UNT,NU], CCMMSN=[FO,UNT]. Products active with active PBE in active Fortra Price Book (derived PBE UnitPrice=0 by design). Scope: distinct active New Maintenance Product2 with MTD PAD = 116 of 1683 (6.9%).
defectStep: V21 step 39 'Derived Pricing Formula' (tier lookup on Maintenance Type Defn AttributeValue; missing attr -> tier=0 -> NetUnitPrice=0). No safe-default tier in the procedure for missing MTD.
proposedFix: Backfill ProductAttributeDefinition rows to add Maintenance_Type_Defn to the ~1497 New Maintenance products currently missing it (particularly the entire FIM CCM family: CCMLSE, CCMMSN, etc.), setting the correct tier value (Standard=0.20 unless a different rate applies per product family). This is a config fix, not a procedure change. A safe-default fallback tier in step 39 would also mitigate future gaps but does not replace the root fix.
notes: ADVERSARIAL VERIFIER CONFIRMS the executor's FAIL/ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT. Config/parity scenario per METHOD_BRIEF (derived-family inconsistency validated by querying real UI-built records + org metadata). Both quotes are real UI-built records -- headless fixture $0 trap does not apply; FIM products are active with active PBE in active Fortra Price Book, so a real rep would add them. BoKS positive control reprices to 71 (=0.20x355) through active V21 with MTD present; identical Force-reprice leaves all FIM CCM new-maint lines at $0/null because the FIM products lack the MTD ProductAttributeDefinition (proven at catalog level, not just per-quote QLIA). Procedure branch ran on valid inputs (isSuccess:true both quotes) and is sound; the gap is missing org config. Both quotes fresh Force-repriced 2026-06-30 on v67.0 API. Corrected scope: 116/1683 (6.9%) active New Maintenance products carry MTD -> 93.1% gap (executor undercounted; gap is larger, not smaller). Matches SC-3346 NewMaint derivation inconsistency documentation.
verdict_reason: Preflight passed: BoKS positive control reprices correctly through V21 (NetUnitPrice=71=355x0.20, Maintenance_Type_Defn QLIA present and IsPriceImpacting=true). FIM CCM maintenance lines net $0/null after fresh V21 Force-reprice because FIM products have NO Maintenance_Type_Defn ProductAttributeDefinition -- V21 step 39 tier lookup finds no MTD value and returns 0. This is an ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT: the FIM CCM product family is missing required pricing configuration (MTD attribute) that any real sales rep building an FIM maintenance line would also hit. The procedure branch ran correctly on BoKS (which has MTD) and correctly returned $0 for FIM (which lacks MTD) -- the procedure logic is sound but the config is incomplete.
